name: Still Unsolved
niche: Real unsolved mysteries and strange events, told in under a minute
rules: Real, well-documented cases only. Every fact must be checked with a web search and listed in sources.
No gore, no graphic descriptions of death, and nothing involving real victims' families. Keep it suitable for a 13+ audience.
Present theories as theories. Never state a disputed claim as fact.
Hook in the first 3 seconds; end on an open question + comment prompt.
